manifest.target: ecosim, a top-down world of creatures
provides: A creature can see other creatures in front of it and can feel a bump when one touches it.
A creature can move, turn, eat, shoot, and say something out loud.
Creatures come in three kinds: carnivores, herbivores, and plants.

inputKinds.name: carnivore-ahead
inputKinds.description: Distance in world pixels at which one carnivore is held directly ahead of the creature under study; 0 takes it out of the world.

inputKinds.name: herbivore-ahead
inputKinds.description: Distance in world pixels at which one herbivore is held directly ahead of the creature under study; 0 takes it out of the world.

inputKinds.name: plant-ahead
inputKinds.description: Distance in world pixels at which one plant is held directly ahead of the creature under study; 0 takes it out of the world.
